title: 23 Loreto Avenue, Dalkey, Co. Dublin, A96 X5F9
seoTitle: 23 Loreto Avenue, Dalkey, Co. Dublin, A96 X5F9
description:
Ideally located on the peaceful and discreet Loreto Avenue, this superbly renovated two-storey residence enjoys a private setting while being conveniently positioned just 200 yards from the centre of Dalkey. Beautifully upgraded throughout, the home now offers stylish modern accommodation, generous living space and an exceptional standard of finish in one of South County Dublin’s premier coastal towns.

Expertly renovated and presented in excellent turnkey condition, the property has been transformed into a bright and exceptionally comfortable four-bedroom home, combining elegant modern finishes with generous living, bedroom and exceptional storage.

The thoughtfully designed interiors create a cosy and stylish atmosphere, with a seamless flow between the living spaces. Double-glazed A-rated windows, modern ceramic electric radiators and an Aeris Eco Wi-Fi system further enhance the comfort and efficiency of the home.  The ground floor has been completely reimagined, featuring a stylish open plan living room and a stunning bespoke kitchen with high-end integrated appliances,  premium quartz worktop and matching backsplash.  Off the kitchen is a small enclosed private courtyard with seating area. The ground floor is further complemented by a generous double bedroom and separate family bathroom, creating a wonderfully private and self-contained space that is ideally suited to welcoming guests while maintaining a sense of privacy and separation from the principal living accommodation.

Upstairs there are four bedrooms, three which are double bedrooms and one single bedroom currently laid out as a home office. A newly fitting bathroom with double shower completes the accommodation. Excellent storage is provided throughout, including particularly large bespoke wardrobes in all bedrooms. The location speaks for itself being just a five-minute stroll from the heart of Dalkey Village, with its boutique shops, artisan cafés, and award-winning restaurants. Enjoy scenic walks to Bulluck & Coliemore Harbours or over Dalkey and Killiney Hills.  Active lifestyle seekers will appreciate the proximity to golf, tennis, GAA and soccer clubs, as well as Dun Laoghaire Harbour's excellent sailing and water sports facilities.
